rec.name: PDP Quantity Selector Beside Add-to-Cart Button
rec.status: Built — delivered, tested internally (source code and documentation available)

what.text: A configurable quantity picker (– / number / +) placed inline next to the Add-to-Cart (ATC) button on the product page. It can sit to the left or right of the ATC button, has rounded (pill) corners instead of square ones, takes custom text and background colors, matches the ATC button height, and can be hidden completely (or on mobile only). Two design variants exist: (1) the picker to the LEFT of the ATC button, and (2) the picker hidden entirely, leaving a full-width ATC button.

why.text: Placing the quantity control right beside the primary CTA keeps the buying decision in one compact row and makes multi-unit purchases easy, which can lift units per order for consumables or bundle-friendly products. Hiding it removes a decision point and a bit of visual noise for single-purchase products, giving a cleaner, more focused CTA. Making both variants available lets the agency A/B test 'more choice and higher AOV' against 'less friction'.

how.text: In the Dawn-style theme: 1) In main-product.liquid, remove the separate quantity_selector block and replace the buy_buttons block schema with one that includes quantity settings (hide, hide on mobile, hide label, text color, background color, position left/right, full-width on mobile, default style on mobile) plus ATC and Buy-now color settings. 2) In product-form.liquid, remove the old quantity_selector code and replace the product-payment-container markup with a flex wrapper (.ed_quantity_and_atc_wrap, with qtty-pos-left/right class) containing the quantity-selector and the ATC button. CSS makes both elements pill-shaped (border-radius 50px) and equal height (--button-height). Position right uses flex order -1 on the ATC button. On mobile, the wrapper stacks in a column with a full-width picker. The dynamic checkout button stays below.

items: Default style at mobile – checkbox (only works with full-width at mobile)
Show recipient form for gift card products – checkbox
Add to cart background and text color
Buy now background and text color

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with main-product.liquid, product-form.liquid, a buy_buttons block, a quantity-selector custom element and a --button-height CSS variable. No app needed and no metafields. Border radius is hard-coded to 50px in the CSS (a rounding setting is not exposed in the theme editor). Code edits are required in two theme files.

images.caption: Variant 1: pill-shaped quantity picker (– 1 +) to the left of a wide, rounded 'Ins Körbchen' ATC button, below the stock status line.
Variant 2: quantity picker hidden; a full-width 'IN DEN WARENKORB' button with payment icons below.
